question: Should this issue be solved by the `sessions.list`-backed dashboard agent-status builtin in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should it wait for a richer `sessions.activity.*` Gateway contract?
rationale: The UI request is clear, but the durable source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing choice that automation should not decide.

options.title: Use the staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the implementation candidate and require its conflicts, proof, and review blockers to clear before closing this issue.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader `sessions.activity.*` contract lands, then implement the widget against that richer stable source.

options.title: Defer to roadmap tracker
options.body: Have https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing while preserving this issue's widget-specific requirements as acceptance criteria.

recommendation.title: Use the staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the implementation candidate and require its conflicts, proof, and review blockers to clear before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice depends on the related Gateway session-activity contract, which is already assigned to vincentkoc in the linked activity issue.
